identity.description: An attacker uses a signed Windows process to load an unsigned binary from an uncommon path, triggering the 'Globally uncommon image load from a signed process' alert. Cortex should detect this behavior via process start and file load telemetry.

expected_artifacts.description: Uncommon file load from signed process

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Image Load from Signed Process
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned binaries being loaded by a signed Windows process from an uncommon execution path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Temp'
| filter action_file_path not contains 'Windows\\System32'
| filter action_file_path not contains 'Windows\\SysWOW64'
